clues.it: Carla era accanto a una pianta e a ovest di Bruno.
clues.en: Carla was beside a plant and west of Bruno.

clues.it: Irene era a ovest di Rosa e in Plancia.
clues.en: Irene was west of Rosa and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Ugo era accanto a una pianta e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Ugo was beside a plant and west of Vito.

clues.it: Vito era nella 4ª colonna e sul Molo, ma non era accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Vito was in the 4th column and on the Dock, but was not beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Marta era in una stanza diversa da Bruno e sul Molo.
clues.en: Marta was in a different room from Bruno and on the Dock.

clues.it: Elena era nella 12ª colonna e accanto a un salvagente, ma non era accanto a una lanterna.
clues.en: Elena was in the 12th column and beside a life ring, but was not beside a lantern.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 5ª colonna e su una rete, ma non era accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 5th column and on a net, but was not beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 9ª colonna, a ovest di Rosa e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 9th column, west of Rosa and in the Galley.

clues.it: Giada era nella 2ª colonna e su una pozza, ma non era accanto a un barile.
clues.en: Giada was in the 2nd column and on a puddle, but was not beside a barrel.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 11ª colonna e accanto a una lanterna, ma non era accanto a uno scaffale.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 11th column and beside a lantern, but was not beside a shelf.

clues.it: Olga era nella 8ª colonna e in Cambusa, ma non era accanto a una lanterna.
clues.en: Olga was in the 8th column and in the Galley, but was not beside a lantern.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Vito lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Giada lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 2nd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 11ª, colonna 11ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 11th, column 11th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga lascia una sola casella libera: riga 12ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Olga's own clue leaves a single free square: row 12th, column 8th.

steps.it: Ugo non può stare nella 1ª riga.
steps.en: Ugo cannot be in the 1st row.

steps.it: Ugo non può stare nella 6ª colonna.
steps.en: Ugo cannot be in the 6th column.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Ugo con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Ugo's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 3rd, column 3rd.

steps.it: Vito può stare solo nella 4ª riga: escludendola, a Elena resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 12ª.
steps.en: Vito can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 6th, column 12th.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 5ª colonna: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 5th column: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 1st, column 6th.

steps.it: Olga può stare solo nella 12ª riga: escludendola, a Bruno resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Olga can only be in the 12th row: ruling it out leaves Bruno a single square: row 8th, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «1 accanto a un barile» non torna senza Marta: deve stare in riga 5ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: The general clue “1 beside a barrel” cannot add up without Marta: they must be at row 5th, column 7th.

steps.it: Carla può stare solo nella 1ª riga: escludendola, a Irene resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Carla can only be in the 1st row: ruling it out leaves Irene a single square: row 2nd, column 10th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 persone in Cabina» non torna senza Nino: deve stare in riga 10ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 people in the Cabin” cannot add up without Nino: they must be at row 10th, column 1st.
